message.content:
You are designing an implementation plan for migrating the "motoboy" (courier) role of a delivery platform ("DeliveryHub") from a custom JWT/bcrypt auth system to real Supabase Auth, matching the pattern already used by customers/restaurant owners. Do NOT write any code — produce a concrete, file-referenced implementation plan only.

# Repos
- Backend, two synced checkouts (apply every backend change to BOTH, they must stay identical):
  - `C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\serer_delivery` (standalone, NestJS/TypeScript)
  - `C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label\server_delivery` (git submodule, same remote/commit as above)
- Frontend: `C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label` (React 18/Vite/Redux Toolkit/Tailwind). `supabase/migrations/` and `supabase/config.toml` live here (root of this repo), not in the backend repos.

# Current state (fully verified by prior exploration — treat as ground truth, do not re-derive)

## Motoboy custom auth (backend)
- `src/motoboy/motoboy-auth.service.ts`: `cadastro()` (self-signup, lines ~135-180) bcrypt-hashes a password into `motoboys.password_hash`, uploads 4 documents to private bucket `motoboy-documentos`, optionally links an already-logged-in customer's Supabase account via `vincularContaCliente()` (sets `motoboys.user_id` + promotes `user_profiles.role='motoboy'`) if a `supabase_access_token` was passed — this is currently OPTIONAL/best-effort. `login()` (~182-200) accepts email-or-phone + bcrypt-compares `password_hash`. `gerarToken()`/`abrirSessao()`/`criarSessaoEToken()` (~79-108) implement a single-active-session lock: on login, atomically does `UPDATE motoboys SET active_session_id=<new uuid>, session_expires_at=now()+30d WHERE id=? AND (active_session_id IS NULL OR session_expires_at < now())` — if no row updated, throws `ConflictException` (already logged in elsewhere). Then signs a custom JWT (`jwt.sign({motoboyId, sessionId}, MOTOBOY_JWT_SECRET, {expiresIn:'30d'})`). `completarCadastro()` (~203-236) is a legacy path for pre-password motoboys. `logout()` clears `active_session_id`/`session_expires_at`.
- `src/motoboy/motoboy.service.ts`: `criarPeloRestaurante()` (~104-139) — restaurant creates a motoboy directly (auto-approved/affiliated), restaurant types a plaintext password in the UI which gets bcrypt-hashed into `password_hash` server-side; NO Supabase Auth user is created. `editarPeloRestaurante()` similarly can update `password_hash`. `forcarLogout()` (~342-350) lets the restaurant clear `active_session_id`/`session_expires_at` to kick a stuck/lost session.
- `src/auth/motoboy.guard.ts`: reads `x-motoboy-token` header, `jwt.verify(token, MOTOBOY_JWT_SECRET)` → looks up `motoboys` by id → requires `is_active` AND `active_session_id === payload.sessionId` AND `session_expires_at` in the future (this is what actually enforces the single-session lock on every request, not just at login) → sets `req.motoboyId`. Legacy fallback path for `access_token` column (only when `precisa_completar_cadastro=true`).
- Controllers: `motoboy-auth.controller.ts` (`POST motoboy/auth/{cadastro,login,completar-cadastro,logout}`), `motoboy-portal.controller.ts` (`@Controller('motoboy')`, `MotoboyGuard`-protected: `GET me`, earnings, orders endpoints — NO profile-edit/PATCH endpoint currently exists, confirm/add if needed), `restaurante-motoboys.controller.ts` (`@Controller('restaurante/motoboys')`, `RestaurantOwnerGuard`-protected, includes `POST :motoboyId/forcar-logout`).
- `MOTOBOY_JWT_SECRET` env var (separate HMAC secret, `.env` in both backend checkouts) — used only in `motoboy-auth.service.ts` and `motoboy.guard.ts`.

## Customer/owner real Supabase Auth (the pattern to replicate)
- 100% client-side account creation: frontend `AuthContext.jsx` `signUp()` calls `supabase.auth.signUp({email, password, options:{data:{name, role}}})` directly — no backend endpoint creates Supabase Auth users for self-service signup. `signIn()` calls `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword()`. Session persisted automatically by the Supabase JS SDK (`persistSession:true`, default localStorage key) via `src/lib/supabase.js`.
- A DB trigger `handle_new_user()` (`supabase/migrations/20260710000001_role_enum.sql`, originally `20250825103853_setup_rls_policies.sql`) fires `AFTER INSERT ON auth.users` and auto-inserts a `public.user_profiles` row: `(id=NEW.id, email=NEW.email, name=COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data->>'name', ...), role=COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data->>'role','customer')::user_role)`. The `user_role` enum already includes `'motoboy'` as a valid value.
- Backend guards verify the Supabase JWT via JWKS (`src/auth/supabase-jwt.service.ts`, `jwks-rsa` client hitting `${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json`, RS256, no shared secret) — NOT via the Supabase SDK. `src/auth/jwt.guard.ts` (`JwtGuard`) reads `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, verifies, sets `req.userId=sub`, `req.userRole=user_metadata.role`. `src/auth/restaurant-owner.guard.ts` (`RestaurantOwnerGuard`) composes `JwtGuard` then looks up `restaurants.user_id=req.userId`, sets `req.restaurantId`. `src/auth/admin.guard.ts` (`AdminGuard`) composes `JwtGuard` then checks `user_profiles.role==='admin'`. THIS composition pattern (a guard that runs `JwtGuard.canActivate` first, then does its own DB lookup) is exactly what a new motoboy guard should follow.
- The only backend-initiated Supabase Auth user mutation today is admin support tooling: `src/usuarios/usuarios.service.ts` `trocarCredenciais()` calls `supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById()` (service-role key). No existing code calls `supabase.auth.admin.createUser()` or `supabase.auth.admin.generateLink()` anywhere yet — these will be new usage but the `supabase` client (service role) is already set up as an injectable `SupabaseService` used throughout (see `src/supabase/`).
- `motoboys.user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL` ALREADY EXISTS (migration `20260714000002_motoboys_user_id.sql`) but is only populated today via the optional `vincularContaCliente()` linking path — most motoboys have it NULL. `motoboys.email` has a partial unique index (`WHERE email IS NOT NULL`), not `NOT NULL`. `motoboys.password_hash` is nullable.

## Frontend motoboy-specific pieces
- `src/pages/motoboy-cadastro/index.jsx` — self-signup form: `name, phone, email, password` (min 6 chars) + 4 file uploads (base64), submits to `motoboyAuthService.cadastro()`, stores returned custom token via `setMotoboyToken()`, navigates to `/motoboy`.
- `src/services/motoboyAuthService.js` — `TOKEN_KEY='motoboy_access_token'` (localStorage), wraps `POST /api/motoboy/auth/{cadastro,login,completar-cadastro,logout}`.
- `src/services/motoboyService.js` — day-to-day API client, attaches `x-motoboy-token` header on every call, re-exports the token getters.
- `src/components/MotoboyGuard.jsx` — pure localStorage check (`getMotoboyToken()`), no Supabase involvement; also handles a legacy `?token=` URL param.
- `src/pages/customer-registration-login/index.jsx` `handleLogin()` — already tries `supabase signIn` FIRST, and only falls back to the custom `motoboyLogin()` if that fails, then redirects to `/motoboy`. This fallback exists BECAUSE motoboys aren't real Supabase users today.
- `src/pages/restaurante-motoboys/index.jsx` `MotoboyFormModal` — restaurant types `name, phone, email, password` (password required on create, optional on edit with helper text "compartilhe... é o login dele").
- `src/components/RestauranteGuard.jsx` — the model to follow for a real Supabase-Auth-based route guard (reads `isAuthenticated()`/`isRestaurantOwner()` from `AuthContext`).
- `AuthContext.jsx` `isMotoboy()` — just `userProfile?.role === 'motoboy'`, already correct/reusable once `user_profiles.role` is actually set to `'motoboy'` for real accounts.
- **`/reset-password` route does not exist anywhere in `Routes.jsx`** — `authService.resetPassword(email)` already calls `supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {redirectTo: `${origin}/reset-password`})` and `authService.updatePassword(newPassword)` already wraps `supabase.auth.updateUser({password})`, but there is NO landing page to receive the recovery-link click and call `updatePassword` — this is a pre-existing gap affecting ALL roles, not motoboy-specific, and must be built now since it's required infrastructure for the motoboy "recuperar senha"/invite-link requirement below.

## Existing local test data
2 motoboys in local DB: `dd@delivery.com` (id 1, self-registered, `criado_por_restaurant_id=NULL`) and `tati@delivery.com` (id 2, `criado_por_restaurant_id=1`). Both currently only have `password_hash`, `user_id` is NULL for both — will need a one-off backfill/migration script (pattern: look at `scripts/seed-primeiro-boot.ts` in both backend repos for the existing style of one-off admin scripts using `supabase.auth.admin.createUser` + service role key) to create real Supabase Auth accounts for them.

# Product decisions already confirmed with the user (non-negotiable constraints for the plan)
1. **Keep the single-active-session lock.** Since Supabase-issued JWTs can't easily carry our own custom session-lock claim without Auth Hooks (extra infra we're not setting up), design it as: after the frontend completes `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword()`, it calls a NEW backend endpoint (Bearer token = the real Supabase access token) that (a) verifies the caller is a motoboy account (`motoboys.user_id = req.userId`), (b) does the same atomic single-session claim as today's `abrirSessao()` (generate a fresh opaque `sessionId`, conditional UPDATE on `active_session_id`/`session_expires_at`, `ConflictException` if already claimed elsewhere), (c) returns that `sessionId` to the frontend. The frontend then sends BOTH the normal `Authorization: Bearer <supabase-jwt>` header (for identity, verified via `SupabaseJwtService`/`JwtGuard` composition) AND a custom header (e.g. `x-motoboy-session: <sessionId>`) on every subsequent motoboy request. The new motoboy guard verifies the Supabase JWT (JwtGuard-style), looks up the `motoboys` row by `user_id`, and ALSO checks `active_session_id === header value` AND `session_expires_at` in the future — exactly mirroring today's `motoboy.guard.ts` logic, just keyed off the Supabase-verified `userId` instead of a custom JWT payload. This preserves `forcarLogout()` (restaurant clears `active_session_id`, which invalidates the session-header check on the motoboy's NEXT request even though their Supabase JWT itself is still technically valid). Design the exact endpoint name/shape, guard changes, and frontend storage of `sessionId` (alongside the Supabase SDK's own session storage) for this.
2. **Email becomes mandatory for motoboy accounts going forward** (both self-signup and restaurant-created). Phone remains a stored contact field but stops being usable as a login identifier for NEW accounts (old `login()` by phone can be retired since real Supabase Auth login is by email).
3. **Restaurant-created motoboy invite flow**: restaurant KEEPS the ability to type a password directly on the creation form (used to call `supabase.auth.admin.createUser({email, password, email_confirm:true, user_metadata:{name,role:'motoboy'}})` server-side instead of bcrypt-hashing into `password_hash`). ADDITIONALLY, the UI should offer generating a "set/reset password" link via `supabase.auth.admin.generateLink({type:'recovery', email})` (service-role backend call, returns a link without necessarily emailing it) that can be copied and shared via a WhatsApp deep link (`https://wa.me/?text=<encoded link>`), PLUS a separate "send by email" button that reuses the same recovery mechanism customers already use (`supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail`, which triggers Supabase's built-in auth email — no custom mailer exists in this codebase and none should be added).

# What "done" looks like (the user's own words)
"Motoboys devem ser usuários da mesma forma [que clientes/donos], poder recuperar senha, ter seu perfil, e ser o seu painel de motoboy." I.e.: (a) real Supabase Auth identity, (b) working forgot/reset-password flow reusing the same infra as customers, (c) a profile view/edit for the motoboy (check if one needs to be added — `motoboy-portal.controller.ts` currently only has `GET me`, no PATCH), (d) `/motoboy` becomes their normal authenticated panel gated by the same kind of guard pattern as `RestauranteGuard`, not a bespoke localStorage token check.

# Constraints from project conventions (do not violate)
- No DTOs/class-validator convention exists yet for most modules — mass-assignment protection is done via explicit field allowlisting (`campos = {...}` objects), not DTOs. Follow that pattern for any new/changed service methods (see `impressoras.service.ts atualizar()`, `produtos.service.ts atualizar()` as references — do not invent a DTO layer).
- IDOR protection convention: always compare `req.userId`/ownership column before returning/mutating a resource (see `PedidosService.buscar()`, `PagamentosService.buscarPorPedido()`).
- Every backend change must be applied to BOTH `serer_delivery` and the `server_delivery` submodule (identical files), and the submodule pointer in `deliveryhub_white_label` must be bumped after.
- Migrations belong in `deliveryhub_white_label/supabase/migrations/` (timestamped filename convention `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_description.sql`, see existing files for style — e.g. `20260820000001_motoboys_gerenciados_pelo_restaurante.sql`). Local Supabase must be restarted/migrated from `deliveryhub_white_label/` (`npx supabase migration up`), and this project also has a LINKED production Supabase project (`delivery_jota`, ref `gkeolhhcptavftwloucj`) — new migrations need `npx supabase db push --linked` after merge, with user confirmation first (mutating real prod DB), never done automatically by Claude.
- Don't add speculative abstractions/feature flags/backwards-compat shims per project's general engineering conventions — this is a real cutover, not a dual-system compromise, EXCEPT where explicitly required above (keeping `password_hash`/`access_token` columns around for audit/rollback safety during transition is fine to mention, but the app should stop reading/writing them for new flows once migrated).

# What I need from you
A concrete, staged implementation plan (staging by logical dependency, not necessarily "phases 1/2/3 must ship separately" — this can land as one coherent change) covering:
1. Exact new/changed SQL migration(s) — column changes if any (e.g., should `password_hash`/`access_token`/`MOTOBOY_JWT_SECRET`-related columns be left alone, or is any ALTER needed?), any RLS policy fix needed (note: existing RLS policy `motoboys_owner` on the table still keys off the legacy `restaurant_id` column, not `criado_por_restaurant_id` — flag whether this plan should touch that or is out of scope).
2. Exact backend files to change/add in both checkouts: new/modified guard, new/modified `motoboy-auth.service.ts` methods (what self-signup becomes, e.g. does `POST /motoboy/auth/cadastro` get replaced by a "complete profile after client-side Supabase signUp" endpoint like `onboarding.controller.ts registrarInicial`'s pattern?), the new "claim session" endpoint from decision #1, changes to `criarPeloRestaurante`/`editarPeloRestaurante` for decision #3, a new profile PATCH endpoint if needed, what happens to old `login()`/`completarCadastro()`/`MOTOBOY_JWT_SECRET`/`motoboy.guard.ts` (retdegrade to unused/removed — be explicit).
3. The one-off backfill script for the 2 existing local motoboys (and how it'd run in production against the 2 real production motoboys, if any — note user hasn't confirmed prod motoboy count, flag as a verification step) — model it on `scripts/seed-primeiro-boot.ts`'s use of `supabase.auth.admin.createUser`.
4. Exact frontend files to change/add: the new `/reset-password` page + route (reusable for all roles), rewritten `MotoboyGuard.jsx` (Supabase-based), changed `motoboy-cadastro/index.jsx` signup flow (client-side `supabase.auth.signUp` + call to the new "complete profile" endpoint), removal of the custom-login fallback in `customer-registration-login/index.jsx` once migration is live, changed `restaurante-motoboys` `MotoboyFormModal` (keep password field + add "gerar link"/"copiar"/"WhatsApp"/"enviar por e-mail" UI), where a motoboy profile view/edit UI should live (new page or a tab/section in `motoboy-portal`), and how `motoboyService.js`/`motoboyAuthService.js` should change (attach real `Authorization: Bearer` + `x-motoboy-session` headers instead of `x-motoboy-token`).
5. Ordering/sequencing that avoids breaking production mid-rollout (this app deploys via `git push origin main`, no CI/CD, no feature flags per project convention) — e.g., should backend changes ship first (additive, old custom-JWT path still working) then frontend, then the backfill script run in prod, then old-path removal as a final cleanup commit? Be concrete about what's safe to deploy together vs. what needs the backfill to have run first.
6. A verification/test plan: what to manually test locally end-to-end (self-signup with email+password → login → forced-logout-from-2nd-device → password reset via link → profile edit; restaurant-created motoboy → WhatsApp-link/email-invite → motoboy sets password → logs in) before this is considered done, given the project's convention of testing real flows before calling something complete (no automated test suite exists for this app based on prior exploration, confirm if that's still true).

Be concrete: name exact files, exact function/endpoint names, and call out any open question you can't resolve from the above that genuinely needs a human decision (keep this list short — most decisions have already been made above). Do not write actual code, just the plan with enough specificity that someone could implement it directly from your description.

-- Vincula o motoboy a uma conta de cliente (Supabase Auth), quando o cadastro de
-- motoboy é feito por alguém já logado como cliente. Usado pra promover
-- user_profiles.role pra 'motoboy' automaticamente nesse caso.
ALTER TABLE public.motoboys
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_motoboys_user_id ON public.motoboys (user_id) WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL;
---
-- Sessão única por garçom/motoboy: bloqueia login em segundo dispositivo enquanto
-- a sessão anterior não expirar (TTL do JWT) ou o estabelecimento forçar logout.
alter table public.garcons
  add column if not exists active_session_id text,
  add column if not exists session_expires_at timestamptz;

alter table public.motoboys
  add column if not exists active_session_id text,
  add column if not exists session_expires_at timestamptz;
---
-- Aprovação de motoboy pela plataforma (admin) — antes de poder ver/solicitar
-- vaga em estabelecimentos, o cadastro precisa ser revisado e aprovado.

ALTER TABLE public.motoboys
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status_plataforma TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendente'
    CHECK (status_plataforma IN ('pendente', 'aprovado', 'recusado')),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS motivo_recusa_plataforma TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS aprovado_em TIMESTAMPTZ,
  -- Quantas vezes o motoboy já pediu revisão depois de recusado — limite
  -- configurável pelo admin (platform_settings.config.motoboy_limite_revisoes,
  -- default 2), pra não deixar pedir revisão infinitas vezes.
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS revisoes_solicitadas INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

-- Motoboys que já existiam antes dessa mudança já estavam ativos/em uso —
-- só cadastros novos daqui pra frente precisam passar por aprovação.
UPDATE public.motoboys SET status_plataforma = 'aprovado', aprovado_em = NOW()
WHERE status_plataforma = 'pendente';

content.content:
-- Motoboys: tabela + colunas em orders

-- Adiciona role motoboy
ALTER TABLE public.user_profiles DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS user_profiles_role_check;
ALTER TABLE public.user_profiles ADD CONSTRAINT user_profiles_role_check
  CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'restaurant_owner', 'customer', 'motoboy'));

-- Tabela de motoboys (acesso via token, sem Supabase Auth obrigatório)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.motoboys (
  id        BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  restaurant_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.restaurants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name      TEXT NOT NULL,
  phone     TEXT,
  access_token TEXT UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::text,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Colunas de rastreamento no pedido
ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS motoboy_id         BIGINT REFERENCES public.motoboys(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS motoboy_lat         DOUBLE PRECISION,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS motoboy_lng         DOUBLE PRECISION,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS motoboy_location_at TIMESTAMPTZ;

-- RLS
ALTER TABLE public.motoboys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY motoboys_owner ON public.motoboys
  FOR ALL USING (
    restaurant_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.restaurants WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
  );
---AUTH_FIELDS---
-- Motoboy vira identidade própria (self-service): login com senha, documentos.
-- restaurant_id fica nullable — a relação motoboy<->restaurante passa a ser N:N
-- via motoboy_estabelecimentos (próxima migration).
ALTER TABLE public.motoboys
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS password_hash TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS foto_perfil_url TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS documento_frente_url TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS documento_verso_url TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS comprovante_endereco_url TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS precisa_completar_cadastro BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

-- Motoboys existentes (criados antes do login por senha) precisam completar cadastro
-- na primeira vez que acessarem com o link antigo.
UPDATE public.motoboys SET precisa_completar_cadastro = true WHERE password_hash IS NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS motoboys_email_unique ON public.motoboys (email) WHERE email IS NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.motoboys ALTER COLUMN restaurant_id DROP NOT NULL;
COMMENT ON COLUMN public.motoboys.restaurant_id IS 'Legado (pré N:N) — mantido só para migração de dados. Usar motoboy_estabelecimentos.';
